comments.body:
Yes. The right place is `orchestrate-handoff.ts`, not the planner prompt.

Current shape:
- `agent-router.yml` forwards the original requester into `/orchestrate`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L1114-L1132
- `agent-orchestrator.yml` carries `requested_by`, planner output, model display, and progress metadata through the orchestrator run: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-orchestrator.yml#L154-L232
- Terminal orchestration comments already live in `orchestrate-handoff.ts`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1057-L1184
- Existing final-response/progress-note merging is already implemented in `progress-final-comment.ts`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/progress-final-comment.ts#L19-L64
- PR marker upsert support already exists via `upsertPrCommentByMarker`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/github.ts#L410-L432

Implementation plan:
1. Add an orchestrator final marker, e.g. `<!-- sepo-agent-orchestrate-final -->`, separate from dispatch handoff markers.
2. Replace the generic terminal stop wording with a final summary formatter that includes:
   - what the orchestration did, using source action/conclusion, target, round, reason, and any planner `user_message`
   - whether no further workflow was dispatched
   - the source run id when available
   - `Requested by @login` only when `requested_by` is a real human-looking requester and not the Sepo app/agent handle/bot
3. For PR targets, update a single existing PR note by marker instead of creating duplicate final comments. If a live progress comment id exists, prefer merging into that note using the existing progress-final-comment helper; otherwise upsert by the new orchestrator final marker.
4. For issue targets, keep the current dedupe behavior but move it to marker-based upsert/update where practical, so reruns revise the final note rather than posting near-duplicates.
5. Update tests that currently assert PR terminal stops stay silent; that test is now the requested behavior gap: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.ts#L1504-L1524
6. Update orchestrator docs where they currently say ordinary terminal PR stops remain silent: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/agent-orchestrator.md#L145-L152

I’d cover this with focused tests for human requester tagging, bot requester suppression, PR final-note upsert, progress-comment merge fallback, and rerun dedupe. Since this was routed as `/answer`, I’m stopping at the plan and waiting for approval before coding.

Also in the final comment we should hide the reviews immediately before if it is shipped or passed? 

@sepo-agent /answer

Yes, I’d add that as part of the same change, but keep it narrow.

Recommended behavior:
- When the orchestrator posts/updates the finalized PR note for a successful terminal state, collapse prior Sepo-generated review noise.
- Treat success as terminal states like `review` + `SHIP`, `agent-self-approve` + `approved`, and `agent-self-merge` + `merged` / `auto_merge_enabled`.
- Do not collapse on blocked, failed, needs-rework, or clarification states, because those comments may still be the actionable context.
- Only minimize trusted Sepo-authored generated comments, not human reviews or discussion.

This fits existing code well:
- Use the existing cleanup toggle `AGENT_COLLAPSE_OLD_REVIEWS`.
- Reuse/extend `collapsePreviousReviewSummaries`, `collapsePreviousRubricsReviews`, `collapsePreviousFixPrComments`, and `collapsePreviousHandoffComments` from https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/review-summary-minimize.ts
- Call that cleanup from the orchestrator terminal/final-comment path in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts, right before or after upserting the finalized note.
- Keep the finalized note visible as the one durable summary, and mark earlier generated review/handoff comments as `OUTDATED`.

So the updated plan is: finalized orchestration note + human requester mention + PR note upsert + conditional cleanup of immediately preceding Sepo-generated review artifacts when the orchestration shipped/passed.
